title: Reference Frames
body: The velocity of a particle in reference frame A is $$((2.0\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}})\hat{i}+(3.0\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}})\hat{j})$$. $$The$$ $$velocity$$ $$of$$ $$reference$$ $$frame$$ $$A$$ $$with$$ $$respect$$ $$to$$ $$reference$$ $$frame$$ $$B$$ $$is$$ $$(4.0\, \tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}})\hat{k}$$, $$and$$ $$the$$ $$velocity$$ $$of$$ $$reference$$ $$frame$$ $$B$$ $$with$$ $$respect$$ $$to$$ $$C$$ $$is$$ $$(2.0\, \tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}})\hat{j}$$.
lesson: 4. Motion in Two and Three Dimensions
